issues.on_page: General Government (line 29): Water Fund 13,476.16, Sewer Fund 10,939.62
issues.issue: Utility fund spending is printed on the governmental General Government line and recorded as general government for business-type, as printed. The page doesn't say whether it is utility operating cost, so it may belong in utilities. Same for detail[17] and detail[20].
The function comes from the fund name, not from the page, and this line has no computed marker for it. The 2026-11-12 FY2022 ruling says capital outlay gets a function only when one is printed.
